stageNote: A provenance-stage freeze. The final freeze (packet eligibility with not-in-packet and egress-stopped, the full packet sources, the packet-dependent synthetic fields and the final corpusSha256) is made once the evals package is bound to the runtime packet code. Nothing may bind to this corpusSha256.

pendingPacketFields: identity.attemptId and roundKey: the chunk id of each packet
priorFindings: the chunk filter on the prior candidates (a prior is shown when its file is in the chunk)
priorFindings[].evidence and requiredFix: the label text, split and masked
the masks applied to each packet part
the packet sources: chunk diffs, repair-delta sections and post-images
